entries.5b3dfaf66c2b0e34: This business provides the CS Set, which combines rental of clothing and towels with laundry service and provision of daily necessities for people hospitalized at hospitals or admitted to nursing facilities. It is a single segment; revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥55,448 million. The Vietnamese consolidated subsidiaries GREEN LAUNDRY JOINT STOCK COMPANY and TMC VIET NAM TRADING AND SERVICE JOINT STOCK COMPANY provide laundry services for hospitals.
entries.d40df02ca99edf01: Headquartered in Matsumoto, Nagano Prefecture, the group consists of the company, six consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate. The company operates a nursing and medical care-related business centered on the CS Set service for inpatients and residents of hospitals and nursing facilities. Consolidated employees as of December 31, 2025 numbered 974.
entries.e67e5212cd27c3ba: A company headquartered in Matsumoto, Nagano Prefecture, that offers the "CS Set" to inpatients and residents of hospitals and nursing care facilities, combining rental of clothing and towels with a laundry service and the provision of daily necessities.
